description: This PHP source file defines a script for repairing activity end dates within the SuiteCRM system. It includes a helper function to calculate end dates for call and meeting records based on start date and duration, and updates the database records accordingly. It also enforces access control and adheres to licensing requirements.

methods.name: calculateEndDate
methods.description: Calculates the end date for an activity (call or meeting) based on start date and duration, with validation and logging.

search-terms: call and meeting end date calculation
